newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut H1 pre-tax profit 13.6 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Beirut H1 pre-tax profit 13.6 bln pounds.

text.p: Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce on Thursday reported mid-year consolidated pre-tax profits of 13.6 billion Lebanese pounds ($8.8 million).
The bank which is traded on the Beirut Stock Exchange said in a statement that 2.8 billion pounds of those profits came from net extraordinary income from the sale of real estate assets.
The bank said its mid-year unaudited consolidated customer's deposits climbed to 933 billion Lebanese pounds from 875.6 billion at the end of 1996.
Consolidated loans rose by 16.7 billion Lebanese pounds in the same period to 343.3 billion.

Last December, BLC completed a $60 million capital increase through simultaneous local and international share offerings. The increase covered the acquisition of BLC France, its Paris subsidiary which split off during the 1975-90 civil war.
